div.div: Object Identity · Direct Pointers · Polymorphic Dispatch

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 78px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Encapsulates business behavior & state invariants
• Traverses rich object graphs via direct pointers
order.customer.tier · order.lines[0].product
• Cyclic and bidirectional object references

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 238px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Class hierarchies and behavioral polymorphism
CorporateOrder & RetailOrder extend Order
• Dynamic method dispatch based on runtime type
• Abstract interfaces decouple callers from subtypes

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 393px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Object equality determined by memory address:
entityA === entityB (same memory reference)
• Independent from persistence primary keys
• Ephemeral lifespan bounded by application session

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 548px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;

div.span:
• Domain operations modify internal entity state:
order.confirmAllocation(inventoryBatch)
• Business rules execute without issuing ad-hoc SQL
• Mutations are collected before transaction commit

div.div: Session Lifecycle Coordination · Instance Isolation · Change Tracking

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 524px; height: 1px; padding-top: 78px; margin-left: 500px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Maintains atomic identity registries throughout the business transaction:
[New] entities to insert | [Dirty] entities with mutated state
[Clean] unchanged reads | [Removed] entities marked for deletion
• Orchestrates deterministic commit pipeline:
Topological Sort (FK Dependencies) ➔ Batched SQL Execution

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 524px; height: 1px; padding-top: 263px; margin-left: 500px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Lookup index: (Class, PrimaryKey) ➔ In-Memory Object Reference
• Guarantees 1 database row = exactly 1 object instance in memory
• Prevents redundant SQL read trips and eliminates dirty-write hazards
• Ensures polymorphic references point to the identical memory instance

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 524px; height: 1px; padding-top: 428px; margin-left: 500px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Bidirectional translation: Domain Object Graph ⟷ Tabular SQL Rows
• Bridges structural mismatch (inheritance strategies, foreign key joins)
• Reconstitutes domain objects with invariants without triggering business events
• Keeps domain code completely clean of table names, columns, or SQL text

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 524px; height: 1px; padding-top: 603px; margin-left: 500px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Optimistic Offline Lock: Validates version_id during SQL update
• Detects and prevents lost updates across multi-step user sessions
• Pessimistic Offline Lock: Exclusive lock sessions for critical workflows

div.div: Tabular Relations · Foreign Keys · ACID Transactions

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 396px; height: 1px; padding-top: 78px; margin-left: 1103px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Flat 2D relational tables: orders, items, customers
• Columnar schemas, fixed types, NOT NULL constraints
• Set-oriented mathematical projections & filters
• Zero direct concept of object behavior or methods

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 396px; height: 1px; padding-top: 238px; margin-left: 1103px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Primary Key identity: orders.id = 1042
• Foreign Key relationships: items.order_id ➔ orders.id
• Enforces referential integrity at storage level
• Join queries (INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN) reconstruct sets

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 396px; height: 1px; padding-top: 393px; margin-left: 1103px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• BEGIN TRANSACTION ... COMMIT / ROLLBACK
• Row locks, table locks, and MVCC isolation levels
• Atomicity guaranteed across multi-row statements
• Immediate durability upon commit to disk

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 396px; height: 1px; padding-top: 548px; margin-left: 1103px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• B-Tree / Hash Indexes on primary and foreign keys
• Write-Ahead Log (WAL) ensures crash recovery
• Disk page buffers and database cache managers
